 Extensometers
Extensometers are measuring devices that are used in materials testing to measure the change in length or width directly on the material sample. The strain is determined based on the deformation of the material. On this page we present a selection of tactile long-travel strain gauges and clip-on strain gauges, as well as optical extensometers. If you are missing the test accessories you require, please contact us. We will find the right solution for you.
